author: Leisler, 1812
habitat: 개펄, 소택지, 내륙과 해안의 맑은 물가

months.note: 4월 중순~5월 중순과 7월 하순~9월 하순에 드물게 나타나며(9월 기록이 가장 많다), 국내에서 기록된 달이다.

summary: 물가와 고지대, 해안에서 번식하고 겨울에는 개펄과 소택지에서 지내는 작은 도요새이다. 내륙과 해안 어디서나 나타나며 대개 맑은 물가에서 생활한다. 겨울깃일 때는 민물도요보다 몸이 작고 더 활발하게 움직인다. 지중해 연안에서 겨울을 나며 유럽의 습지를 거쳐 이동한다.
young: 어린새는 무늬가 고우며, 등 아래쪽의 깔끔한 흰 줄무늬로 쉽게 알아볼 수 있다.

similar.how: 겨울깃일 때 작은도요가 더 작고 더 활발하게 움직인다.
여름깃·겨울깃 모두 세가락도요와 비슷하지만 작은도요는 색이 흐리지 않다.

art.subject: Little Stint (Calidris minuta), juvenile, as seen on Korean wetlands in autumn (August–October): crown streaked dark and rufous, with a split whitish supercilium; face pale with a dusky ear spot; throat white; mantle and scapulars black-centred with bright rufous fringes, and a bold creamy-white V along the edges of the mantle; wing coverts and tertials dark-centred with rufous-buff edges; breast sides washed orange-buff with fine dark streaks, centre of the breast white; belly clean white; bill short, fine, straight and black; dark eye; legs black.
art.pose: foraging actively at the edge of shallow clear water
art.scene: Korean autumn wetland: open mudflat beside a marsh with shallow clear water; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding (May), side view standing: rufous-orange face, neck sides and breast sides finely spotted dark, white throat, black-centred rufous-fringed upperparts with a creamy V on the mantle, clean white belly, short fine straight black bill, black legs
juvenile (autumn), back view standing: dark rufous-fringed upperparts with a neat creamy-white V of stripes down the mantle edges, compact dumpy shape, black legs
adult winter, side view standing: grey-brown upperparts with dark feather centres giving a spotted look, grey wash on the breast sides, white underparts, black bill and legs
art.build: Tiny, compact, dumpy sandpiper, about sparrow-sized and clearly smaller than Dunlin, with a round head, short neck and fairly upright stance. Bill black, short, straight and fine-tipped, slightly shorter than the head. Legs black, short. At rest the wingtips reach the tail tip or slightly beyond. In flight a narrow white wing-bar and a dark centre to the rump and tail with white sides. Feeds with quick, busy pecking while running.
avoid: Do not colour the throat plain brick-red; that is Red-necked Stint (Calidris ruficollis) — the Little Stint's throat stays white.
Do not paint yellowish or greenish legs; those belong to Long-toed and Temminck's Stints.
Do not paint a long, drooping bill or a Dunlin-sized body; the bill is short, straight and fine.
Do not paint white outer tail feathers; that is Temminck's Stint (Calidris temminckii).
